description: Numerical outer-slot instantiation agrees with the existing shared-syntax instantiation operation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.named_instantiate.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (a : L.BoundedFormula ℕ 1) (t : L.Term ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.instantiate S
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.namedCode S a)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.termCode S
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.auxName t) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.namedCode S
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiate a t)
